title: Merge the playlists
scenario: Two playlists are sorted shortest to longest. Merge them into one sorted playlist.

intro.job: Two playlists are sorted shortest to longest. Merge them into one sorted playlist.

idea.rule: The leftovers still count — when one list runs out, append the rest of the other.
idea.detail: Two fingers, one at the front of each playlist. Compare the two songs they point at, move the shorter one to the new playlist, and step that finger forward. When one playlist runs out the comparing is over — but the other playlist may still have songs, already in order, that belong on the end.

watch.code:
a, b = pair
out = []
i = 0
j = 0
while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
    if a[i] <= b[j]:
        out.append(a[i])
        i += 1
    else:
        out.append(b[j])
        j += 1
out = out + a[i:] + b[j:]
print(out)

model_restatement: Combine the two sorted lists into one sorted list, keeping every item.

clarify.question: What if both playlists have the same number?
clarify.answer: Keep both — either order is fine.

clarify.question: Could a playlist be empty?
clarify.answer: Not today — each has at least one song.

clarify.question: Can I just sort everything?
clarify.answer: That works — but here, use the order that's already there.

clarify_fallback: Good question — assume the simple case.
blueprint: Walk both playlists with two fingers. While both have songs, move the shorter one to the new playlist. Print the new playlist.

why_line: The loop stops the moment the second playlist runs out (j reaches 3) — the 9 is still waiting on the first playlist, and nothing after the loop picks it up.

explain.rule: Stopping when one playlist is empty is closing up shop while customers are still in line — whatever's left on the other playlist never gets served.
explain.bridge: When the loop ends, which playlist still has songs — and where do they go?

fix.rule: After the loop, out + a[i:] + b[j:] tacks on whatever's left — one of the two slices is empty, the other is already sorted.

walk.gloss: While both playlists still have songs...
Move it to the new playlist, and step that finger forward.
One playlist ran out — add the rest of the other, already in order.
